title: Li-Ning Men's RED Hare 9 PRO Racing Running Shoes US$59.84 (~AU$85.17) Delivered @ LINING Official Store via AliExpress
body:
Deal: Li-Ning Men's RED Hare 9 PRO Racing Running Shoes US$59.84 (~AU$85.17) Delivered @ LINING Official Store via AliExpress

[adrianhughes1998] Great shoe, running with it right now. Very cushiony for everyday walking too.
Absolute steal, why pay double the price for what western brands are out there, when you can have this banger.
[tunzafun001] I'm guessing these are skinny in the forefoot area.
[Juice08] for some reason comes to USD$55.24 for me but only letting me use $1 of coins
[Herszek] Maybe try adding them to your cart first, then in the app’s homepage, click the “Coins” tab and look for them there. You might get lucky and find an even lower price. I did this last time when I bought them. Not sure what's the logic behind it.
[Juice08] wow this actually worked! but you won't get TCB UK cashback with the app I think?
[Herszek] ofc you will, log in in the browser to topcashback.uk and that will pop the ali app - all my today's purchases tracked within 10 mins. For the best tracing I always log in to fresh topcashback page - with unclicked "remember me"
[adrianhughes1998] Every online review I've seen say it's true to size, haven't had any issues myself (13 US).
[jetblack] True to size imo.
I find it pretty rare that sizes are all that far off in any brand. Are people really finding sizes of shoes vary that wildly? I have like 5-6 different brands and styles of shoes, all the same size.
[EBC] I'm between 9 and 10.5 depending on the shoe. Drives me nuts.
[Gunnar] If it's true to size I would say so.
Also, Nike's sizing changes by the shoe type. E.g. I use a US11 mostly but can size down to 10.5 (or even 10) for Jordan 1 and 6s; I need to size up to 11.5 for Huaraches
[Glenningvalley] I've got a set of these with about 350km on them. Great everyday trainer and comfortable getting into some tempo aswell.
[Juice08] how far can you run in an everyday trainer? Like if I do 10kms at 6min/km?
[ferguson] You'll be easily fine for that pace and distance.
[Juice08] cool thanks. find my Pegasus 40's with not many miles on them start to hurt my feet after 6kms.
[ihfree] I've done 17kms in the 8s at around that pace. Also run intervals in them.
YMMV.
[carlosthedwarf] Most of the reviews I've read said they're a bit firm for daily training but good for speed workouts, nice to know someone is using them for daily runs though.
[RainInWinter] So they are not non-marking shoes, are they?
[stingyindian] I thought only the badminton or similar court use shoes need to be non making?
[carlosthedwarf] They do everything, also signed Stephen Curry recently. Their basketball shoes are fantastic.
[ihfree] Also signed Japanese marathon star Suguru Osako who holds the national record.
[Kabal] They're basically just Chinese Nike at this point
[reactor-au] True to size but I found runs narrow toe box
[dtc] How wide are they - if I can’t fit into a megablast but an Evo Sl is ok?
[Snitz] Bought the Li-Ning Men's FEIDIAN 6 CHALLENGER this afternoon, I'm injured and cant run for a few weeks so filling the hole by buying shoes. Will be my first foray into Chinese runners. Want to try the dynafish but ali is much easier to buy from than taobao.
[carlosthedwarf] Been wanting to get the Dynafish too but not willing to jump through hoops or pay nearly $200 for them. These for $84 will do nicely for the time being.
[tencents] Got this from Taobao $56 delivered.
Nice shoe for slower pace jobs and walks. Little narrow.
[jetblack] Hah. My knees are cooked from running city2surf in the feidian 6 challenger. Probably more due to lack of training in them and going harder than I normally would.
Would not recommend jumping straight into them if you're coming off an injury
[ihfree] Interesting - what shoes do you normally run in?
I've done a few 10ks in the Challenger 4 and just picked up the 5 for long runs with faster pace in them.
[adrianhughes1998] I got black with hints of lime green. Slick as anything.
Just ordered XTEP 2000km 5.0 Pro in lime green just today.
[Eyepeex] I have too many shoes. The dynafish xiaonian, red hare 9 ultra and qiaodan leili 1.0s. Will exercise self restraint.
[ihfree] What do you recommend between the Dynafish and Ultra?
[cephh] seems like the verdict is that they're a little narrow, so probably not
[soulfuljyl] Nice got one since i've got their hoodies, track pants, top, tshirts……
[websalad] When trying to apply the coupon code I get:
"For security reasons your request can't currently be processed"
Anyone else got this or know how to fix? I'll try again later.
[CheapGit] I got the Qiaodan Leili 2.0 delivered last week, soft and bouncy easy run shoe. Pretty impressed for the under $80 i paid.
https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005012720554586.html
[nekov] me too, I bought it more for walking but they're a bit too soft for that.
[SaveTheManuals] Any alternative suggestions that have slight arch support for flat feet?
[Cheapsize] li ning Chaoying. With Red Hare 9 you can switch out the innersole no problem as well.
[SaveTheManuals] But I've heard the Red Hare is very narrow?
[Cheapsize] It's narrower right at the top. The shape is literally like a Yeezy 350 but the very middle is different. I just compared them and I placed them over each other but Red hare is narrower in the middle like a Nike Pegasus. So I would say it's basically Adidas sizing. Accidentally went up half a size and it feels very very slightly loose but I like looser shoes anyway. Could go tts or half up either way.
[Cheapsize] Yeah superlight but they have a lot of ventilation. Wouldn't recommend for a Melbourne or Tassie Winter. Similar feel to Adidas Ultraboost
[mit] For a little more, people might also consider the feidian challenger if you want it for workouts. Most definately harder on the legs as you'd expect with the carbon plates.
[Archdon] I have both, these are a bit less bouncy / cushiony - the foam feels firmer vs the Evo SL, but much much more stable.
[FOX] Waiting for our refugee friend syswong to make some CPC comments lol 🤣
